spans.s:
निव॑त् f. depth, valley;
 instr. = seq.
निवना॑ adv. downhill, adown.
निवर॑ m. covering, protection or protector.
नीवा॑र m. wild rice.
†निवर्त a. causing to return.
निवर्तनीय a. to be brought or kept back.
निवर्तयितव्य a. = prec.
निवर्तितव्य a. = prec.
निवर्त्य a. = prec.
निवर्तिन् a. returning, abstaining from (abl.).

निवसन n. putting on;
 cloth, garment.
निवासन n. dwelling, abode.
निवस्तव्य n. (it is) to be lived or spent.

1 निवात॑ a. windless;
 n. such a spot.

2 निवात॑ a. unimpeded, secure;
 n. security.
निवातस्थ a. standing in a windless place.

निवाप m. seed or a sown field;
 also = seq.
निवापाञ्जलि m. an oblation to the Manes.
निवापोदक n. a libation to the Manes.
निवारण a. & n. keeping back, warding off (acc. or —˚).
निवारणीय a. to be kept off.
निवार्य a. to be kept off.

1 निवास m. clothing;
 a. clothed in (—˚).

2 निवास m. stopping, dwelling;
 resting-place, abode, home.
निवासरचना f. architecture, edifice.

निवासवृक्ष m. a tree (serving) as resting-place (for
a bird).
1 निवासिन् a. clothed in (—˚).

2 निवासिन् a. dwelling, staying or being in (loc. or —˚);
m. inhabitant.
निविड v. निबिड.

नि॑वीत a. = seq.;
 also n. as subst.
निवीतिन् a. wearing the sacred thread round the neck.
निवेदक (f. ˚दिका*) telling, relating (—˚).
निवेदन a. & n. relating, announcing.

निवेदयिषुकाम^1 a. wishing to relate.*
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160419. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/290. note: nivedayizu-kAma. nivedayizu is spelling in mw, pw and some other dictionaries. Presume 'itu' is misprint.
निवेद्य a. to be related or communicated.
निवेशिन् a. being in, lying near, resting on (—˚).
निवेश्य a. to be founded (town) or married (man).
1 निवेष्य॑ m. whirlpool or whirlwind.
2 निवेष्य॑ a. belonging to a whirlpool, whirling.
निवेष्ट m. ˚न n. covering, clothing.
निवेष्टव्य n. (it is) to be married (of a man).

{#{{nivezwukAma->nivezwakAma||20160419|Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/290|nivezwa from niviz;
 presume the 'wu' is misprint}}#} a. wishing to marry.
नीव m. a kind of tree.
नीवारकण m. rice-grain.
नीवि॑ f. a cloth or girdle worn round a woman's waist.
नीवी f. a cloth or girdle worn round a woman's waist.
